Q&A

12 species. Most common: Tentacool (100 %), Magikarp (100 %), Horsea (84 %). The rarest catch is Psyduck (1 %). All rates are the summed encounter slots from PokéAPI (FireRed).

Yes, there are differences. The versions differ on Route 13 like this: Oddish only in FireRed (35%); Gloom only in FireRed (5%); Psyduck only in FireRed (1%); Bellsprout only in LeafGreen (35%); Weepinbell only in LeafGreen (5%); Slowpoke only in LeafGreen (1%); Krabby: 20% (FR) vs. 84% (LG); Horsea: 84% (FR) vs. 20% (LG)
